messages:
Priya Patel: Quick weekly pulse — p95/p99 snapshot by route+model, streaming vs non-streaming. Pasting a short extract, please skim and flag anything risky for accounts. @Marco @Aisha please review before EOD.

Priya Patel: ```
2026-03-20 UTC snapshot:
/ generate  | model: gpt-open-8q    | streaming   p95=210ms  p99=480ms
/ generate  | model: gpt-open-8q    | non-stream  p95=320ms  p99=950ms
/ chat      | model: rw-10b         | streaming   p95=120ms  p99=300ms
/ chat      | model: rw-10b         | non-stream  p95=150ms  p99=420ms
/ embed     | model: embed-2        | streaming   p95=40ms   p99=70ms
errors: overall 0.12% (no large spike)
```

Marco Ruiz: Non-stream /generate p99 at 950ms stands out. Any error-rate or retry storms?

Aisha Khan: No global error spike, but infra saw ded-pool-3 queueing bump 09:10-10:30 PST. I'll pull traces and top-requests.

Ken Zhao: Heads up — BrightPath contract has a renewal SLA clause: tail >500ms for 3 consecutive days is a risk trigger. We hit 950ms p99 today on that route.

Priya Patel: Ok agreed actions: 1) client-side: recommend streaming/partial responses to reduce tail 2) infra: temporary routing fallback to smaller model for /generate non-stream bursts 3) CS: proactive note to BrightPath + enablement doc.

Marco Ruiz: @Aisha can you attach Grafana panel and top traces? I'll open a routing change PR if traces show model-size is the driver.

CS-Bot: Grafana panel created: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/xyz123/p95-p99-routing-matrix (access: redwood-internal).

Aisha Khan: Panel + traces attached. Quick read: long tails correlate with seq_len >1024 and zero KV-cache-hit. Many of these requests are non-streaming with large prompt bundles.

Aisha Khan: Patching model config to set non-stream max_seq=1024 and enable aggressive kv-cache warmup in staging now.

Marco Ruiz: I'll prep a routing rule to fallback /generate non-stream -> rw-10b-small when pool utilization > 75%. ETA ~2h for rollout to staging, then can promote.

Ken Zhao: I'll draft an email to BrightPath: explain root cause, immediate mitigations, recommended client streaming integration, and timeline. Will share for review.

Priya Patel: Owners: Marco = routing change, Aisha = model config patch + monitoring, Ken = customer outreach + enablement. I'll follow up in tomorrow sync with updated p99 numbers.

Aisha Khan: Staging patch applied, monitoring p99 now. Will post a 30-min update.

CS-Bot: Alert ded-pool-3 queueing cleared at 2467891500.

Marco Ruiz: :thumbsup: noted, pushing PR now.
